text_block_list.text:
Amidst my hazy consciousness, always... the same question surfaces.
"If I had known this outcome back then... what would I have done?"

......I ponder, knowing it's entirely in vain.
Because... the answer is always the same.

And so... my consciousness drifts away once more. Even as everything blurs...
I feel it, vividly. That inescapable presence, even now... still...—

Where did it all begin? Even now, I can no longer tell.
Yet amidst the faint memories, what comes rushing back with fierce dread is—

That summer.
That sweltering day, hot enough to rot the very mind.

That night when I encountered a primal instinct that knew no slumber...
Yes, it was on my way back from helping out with external duties as a rookie Trainer—

Suddenly, I noticed my own quickening pace. Even as an adult,
a deserted night felt somewhat lonely, eerie... and terrifying.
choice_data_list: (Strange... It's supposed to be hot, yet... I feel cold.)

text_block_list.text:
A single drop of cold sweat trickled down my back. That voice, so faint
I almost mistook it for an illusion, was the trigger that opened the floodgates.

C　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　ome

Before I knew it, I was standing on an unfamiliar hilltop. What on earth
had happened to me...? Before I could even think, my eyes were captivated—

Waxen pale skin that let no starlight through...
And an eerie, dark radiance—eyes so chillingly, terrifyingly crimson.

...What a lovely dark night.
Yet, it's still... still too bright... Ah... aah...

Aah...!! ...I want to be filled...
More... even more... Yes... indeed, that's right—
Let's devour even the moon.
—...Ngh, haah... haah... Aaah, aah, aah...!!
...Aha.

Aha, ha! AhahaHAHAHAHAhahaHAHAHAHA!!
AaaaAAAHhhAAAaaAAaah............AHAHAhaha!!

A scream steeped in pure ecstasy echoed through the void.
Her figure, tearing across the ground as if bare instinct itself had taken form—

I trembled with fear so intense I wanted to back away. Yet for some reason...
my feet took one step, then another... moving toward her.

My reason screamed, 'Stay away from THAT.'
Yet driven by an irresistible force—my instincts were fiercely drawn in.

She was freezing cold, terrifying.
And... searingly, breathtakingly beautiful.
Found you.
Found you...
F O U N D   Y O U U U U U u............!!
Give me—everything you have.

—The last thing I remember were those crimson eyes burning with ecstasy.
And pain. A deep, searing pain... as if my very soul had been reaped.

When I woke up, I was collapsed in my entryway, drenched in cold sweat.
...Could everything from last night have been just a nightmare brought on by the heat?

I instinctively clutched my neck. Looking in the mirror, there was a red mark
on my throat that I had no memory of getting. Looking at that bite-like mark—
Give me—everything you have.

—Driven by an overwhelming impulse, I dashed out of the room.
My heart was pounding fiercely... Was it from terror, or was it...
Excuse me...

I couldn't banish it from my mind—that ferocious, unrestrained running style...
Unabashed and raw, something that would make anyone furrow their brow—
choice_data_list: (I just can't get it out of my head...!)

text_block_list.text: Um...
choice_data_list: (I'm sure she was wearing our academy's uniform... If so—)

text_block_list.text: Excuse me...!!

...I-I am so sorry...
I didn't mean to startle you...

It's just... well, I felt so terrible...
...Are you all right? —About yesterday...

Suddenly, our eyes met—those crimson irises... Standing so fragile before me
that a gentle breeze might blow her away... was unmistakably that same girl.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I am Still.
...Still in Love—
